about: Made-up situations for designing and testing a Lane 2 tool. No scenario describes a real person, project or city decision.

scenarios.title: A homeowner adding an ADU
scenarios.who: A first-time applicant in one Orange County city.
scenarios.in_their_words: Which forms do I need, in what order, and how long will each step take?
scenarios.what_good_looks_like: The city's own checklist and fees, linked and dated, with the state rule shown wherever the city form disagrees with it.

scenarios.title: A nonprofit project manager comparing cities
scenarios.who: Manages a small project that could go in one of two cities.
scenarios.in_their_words: Which city gets me to a ministerial approval faster?
scenarios.what_good_looks_like: A side-by-side of the steps, documents and published timelines, with gaps marked 'unknown' rather than guessed.

scenarios.title: A permit tech who wants to get it right
scenarios.in_their_words: I want to tell applicants the right answer the first time, even when our form is out of date.
scenarios.what_good_looks_like: Answers that cite the state law and any HCD letter, and flag when the city form may be stale.
